Power-ups & Candy

Spend family Candy and money to raise Power (max +10), and every way to get Candy.

Each family has its own Candy (kept for its first stage). Candy + money raise a Pokémon's Power from +0 to +10: each step is +3% all stats and 5% stronger at its role. Levels stop at the Gym cap, so Power is what makes your trained Pokémon better than the rest of the PC.

Money = level × 60 × (Power + 1)^1.5. Legendaries cost ×1 Candy and ×2 money.

Getting Candy

SourceCandy
Catching or hatching one3 (+3 for a Shiny, Void or Prismatic)
Sending one to the Professor1 (+1 Rare, +4 Legendary, +2 special look)
Buddy findsMostly its own family Candy (see Buddy)
Get, on a Pokémon's card1 Rare Candy = 3 Candy of that Pokémon's family (1 for a legendary family)
Raid defeat13 of the boss's family
Friend gifts6–15 of a party family (35% of gifts)
Stamp book family sets10 × the family size

Inherit

Pass one Pokémon's Power onto a better copy of the exact same species (Party & PC). The new one gets the Power; the old one stays with everything else (level, moves, item) and its Power goes back to 0. Move Tutor moves are shared.
